Verified the actual implementation:
- `src/DevSquadAdoWorkflowWatcherPass.ts:623` captures the submitted request independently. History validation at `:698–710` precedes retry-precondition refresh at `:713`.
- `src/DevSquadAdoWorkflowWatcherLedger.ts:504–555` applies the shared checkpoint validator: accepted revision equals submitted expected + 1; operation, timestamp and states agree; latest-equals-accepted additionally requires matching authority and patched cursors.

**36 independently authored, in-memory public-pass probes passed**, separate from repository tests:

| Boundary | Independent result |
|---|---|
| Original A: accepted5/latest5/cursor480; B: accepted6/latest6/cursor480 | Both fail `ledger-unavailable` / `ledger-fault`, checkpoint revision null, no cursor changes or signals, exactly one cleanup attempt. |
| Contradictory revision, previous/resulting state, owner, fence, missing authority, timestamp, PR cursor, duplicate history and required getter | Fail closed without unacknowledged effects. |
| Valid same/latest history; newer mutation, renewal, takeover or release | Original accepted revision and one signal preserved; rejected cleanup remains separately reported. |
| Ambiguous retry without renewal | Same operation, patch, authority and expected revision; one acknowledged signal. |
| Renewal before submission or retry | Submission uses refreshed expected revision; recovery validates that submission—not stale pre-renewal metadata. Forged acceptance against the earlier expected revision is rejected. |
| Receipt appears after the recovery read | Unchanged request replays successfully. Renewal changes the request digest and produces terminal `idempotency-conflict`, without changing operation ID or fabricating effects. |
| Request mutation, unrelated getters, final checkpoint/release cancellation, cleanup fault | Prior privacy, snapshot, cancellation and acknowledged-effect guarantees preserved. |

Receipt behavior was also traced in `DevSquadAdoWorkflowLedgerStorage.ts:637–652,1364–1390,1422–1498`: normalized request digest, receipt lookup before preconditions, and acceptance at current revision + 1.
